title: Table levitation at family seances

tellings.difference: Describes table knocking rather than levitation, with no time or place given.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same table phenomena from Levenda's early sessions that telling 7 describes.

plain: As children in the Bronx, New York, in the mid-1960s, a family is said to have held seances where the table rose off the floor. The author Peter Levenda says he was there, recalling that "we actually had paranormal phenomenon" as kids. In another moment he describes it differently, as the table knocking rather than lifting, and gives no time or place. He tells it as his own early brush with the unexplained.
